meta.description: Your ideas. One creative workspace. Create images, video and audio, and connect your process with AI agents and workflows in Aquora.

reelty.tagline: AI real-estate marketing. Listing photos in — tour video, captions and ads out.
reelty.slow: Reelty is taking a sec — open it in a new tab ↗

landing.sub: Create images, video and audio, then connect your process with agents and workflows. Choose a studio, describe your idea and review the result in one place.
landing.studiosSub: Start with what you want to make. Each studio brings the right tools into focus.

blurbs.image: Generate images from a prompt or a reference.
blurbs.layers: Enhance, relight, re-angle and edit in layers.
blurbs.video: Text or images to video with Kling, Veo, Sora.
blurbs.audio: Music and sound from a single prompt.
blurbs.clipping: Pull the best moments out of long videos.
blurbs.motion-control: Drive a character with reference-video motion.
blurbs.lipsync: Portrait plus audio becomes a talking video.
blurbs.body-swap: Recast anyone in a video with your character.
blurbs.cinema: Explore camera, lens and aperture prompts.
blurbs.marketing: Product shots in, video ads out.
blurbs.agents: Agents that plan and generate for you.
blurbs.design-agent: A canvas agent that designs with you.
blurbs.ai-influencer: Consistent AI personas, post after post.
blurbs.reelty: Listing videos and ads for real estate.

landing.reeltyBody: Open Reelty for property-focused listing videos and marketing content.
landing.trust: Aquora brings creative AI tools into a shared workspace. Download results you want to keep; generation history is stored on this device.
landing.footerRuns: Runs on Aquora's own AI backend (fal.ai + OpenRouter)
landing.accessNote: Workspace access is managed by your administrator. No installation required.
landing.capabilityNote: A focused space for your next idea.
landing.goalHeading: What would you like to create?
landing.availabilityNote: Available models and tools depend on your workspace configuration. Generation may use your daily AI budget.
landing.previewPrompt: A quiet mountain landscape, soft morning light, natural colours.
landing.previewCaption: Illustrative preview — create your own result in the studio.
landing.processHeading: From a clear brief to a result you can use.
landing.processSub: Keep the controls you need, with a direct path from your first prompt to your next creative iteration.

steps.title: Choose a studio
steps.body: Select images, video, audio or a tool for your specific task.

steps.title: Describe and configure
steps.body: Write your prompt, add any required references, and review the model settings and estimated cost.

steps.title: Generate, review and download
steps.body: Follow the job status, inspect the result and download it. Adjust your brief for the next version.

images.title: Create and edit images
images.body: Generate visuals from a prompt, refine existing images and explore a canvas for your creative work.

video.title: Bring ideas to video
video.body: Turn text or images into clips, or choose a focused tool for motion, editing and product videos.

audio.title: Make music and sound
audio.body: Describe the sound you need and create audio for your content using the available models.

agents-automation.title: Connect your creative process
agents-automation.body: Build an assistant or connect generation steps in a reusable visual workflow.

landing.reeltyNote: Reelty opens a connected application with its own access and availability.
